description: Apply a finalized PrivatePAY x402 payment to an existing paid job and execute it once. Use this instead of submit_payment for a job created with payment_mode=privatepay; it consumes supplied payment proof, may settle funds, and returns workflow evidence.

inputSchema.description: Verify and settle a PrivatePAY x402 payment for a job. The signature is forwarded only to the configured facilitator and is never exposed in the public receipt.

payment_signature.description: The x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value returned by the paying agent wallet.

name: privatepay_job_payment

outputSchema.description: Private payment application result for a selected job.

receipt.description: Public evidence receipt when execution completes.

status.description: Job or payment state after applying the supplied x402 proof.

title: PrivateDAO Paid Workflow Payment
